summary: Built ExternalReviewPage (UC5), the OTP-secured external-party screen for reviewing and redlining only the current contract version. The page gates on OtpVerificationForm (locks after 3 failed attempts per UC5-AF-002), shows the expired-link message per UC5-AF-003, and once verified renders the version banner, the restricted-view notice (UC5-BR-016), the clause list and a comment/redline panel wired to the external submit endpoint (UC5-BR-006/UC5-BR-020). Routed at /negotiation/external/:linkToken. Lint, test (5 new tests, 35/35 total) and build all pass; visually verified at 1440x900 against a local fixture server — layout, labels, badges and colors closely match IMG-8/IMG-9.

code_files.description: Route-level page for the OTP-secured external party review screen; orchestrates OTP verification, locked/expired states, version banner, clause list and the redline/comment submission flow.
OTP entry form that tracks consecutive failed attempts client-side and locks the link after the third failure (UC5-AF-002).
Calls POST /negotiation/external/{linkToken}/submit with the external party's redline/comment.

Typed client for the negotiation resource group; currently implements only the two EXTERNAL_PARTY endpoints this page calls (verify-otp, submit) — internal endpoints (GET tracker, POST reviews, POST external-link) are left for the NegotiationTrackerPage task to add alongside.
Zustand store matching the negotiationSlice contract (contractId, routing, negotiationStatus, versionNumber, versions, comments); populated minimally from the external view after OTP success.
Screen-level tests: pre-verification OTP gate, successful verification reveal, 3-attempt lockout, expired-link message, and external submit wiring.

pr.title: feat(ui-gen): ExternalReviewPage for UC5 external party redline/review
pr.body: Implements ExternalReviewPage per T-EXTERNAL-REVIEW-PAGE-UI: OTP-gated access with 3-attempt lockout (UC5-AF-002), expired-link messaging (UC5-AF-003), restricted external view hiding internal routing/reviewer data (UC5-BR-016), and redline/comment submission that triggers AI re-analysis and reverts status to With Internal (UC5-BR-006/UC5-BR-020). Adds lifecycleNegotiationService.js, negotiationSlice store, and the OtpVerificationForm component.

blockers: Inferred fields on NegotiationExternalViewResponse not present in context.json's DTO list, derived from what IMG-8/IMG-9 plainly show: `contractTitle` (string, for the banner heading — no DTO field carries a human-readable contract/counterparty name), `expiresAt` (datetime, to compute the 'Expires in Xh Ym' badge and Access Window), and `clauses` (array of { clauseId, clauseCategory, summary, changeStatus: 'Redlined'|'Unchanged' }, for the per-clause list with status badges — the contracted DTO only offers a single `documentText` blob). The page degrades gracefully when these are absent: it falls back to `Contract {contractId}`, omits the countdown badge, and renders raw `documentText` instead of a clause list, so it never fabricates data the real backend doesn't send.

TASK.md lists GET /negotiation (tracker), POST /negotiation/reviews, and POST /negotiation/external-link as endpoints 'you must call', but none of the three are reachable or relevant from this page: all three are role-restricted to CONTRACT_OWNER/LEGAL_REVIEWER/APPROVER/TENANT_ADMIN, while this screen is EXTERNAL_PARTY-only (auth_required: false on its two real endpoints). They are left unimplemented here as out of scope for ExternalReviewPage and are expected to be wired by NegotiationTrackerPage instead; lifecycleNegotiationService.js is structured so that task can add them alongside without touching what's here.

ExternalSubmitRequest requires a non-nullable `redlineText` plus optional `commentText`, but the TARGET DESIGN shows only a single 'Your Comment' textarea — there is no second free-text control for a distinct tracked redline. The page submits the same textarea value as both `commentText` and `redlineText` (falling back to the unmodified `documentText` for `redlineText` if the comment is empty) rather than inventing a second UI field the design doesn't show.

'Save Redline' (bottom-left button in the comment panel) has no corresponding draft-save endpoint in the contract — only the state-changing `submit` endpoint exists, which triggers AI re-analysis and reverts negotiationStatus per BR-6/BR-20. Calling it on every keystroke/save would mean every 'save' prematurely re-routes the contract, so 'Save Redline' is a local-only no-op placeholder and does not call the API; only 'Submit Changes' calls POST .../submit.

EXTERNAL_PARTY is not among the five roles CLAUDE.md's 'Auth headers' section declares (TENANT_ADMIN, CONTRACT_OWNER, LEGAL_REVIEWER, APPROVER, SIGNER), even though the module contract's endpoint table assigns it to the two endpoints this page calls, both with auth_required:false. The shared http client still attaches its default dev X-User-Role/X-User-Id headers on every request per CLAUDE.md, which is harmless here since the server does not require them for this flow, but it means this screen can't be role-gated the way ClauseAnalysisPage is.

No design frame shows the pre-OTP-verification state (every provided TARGET DESIGN image is already past verification, with the OTP box showing a 'Verified' badge) or the AF-002 locked / AF-003 expired states. The OTP entry form, lockout banner and expired-link banner were built from the acceptance criteria text only (exact copy: 'Invalid OTP. Link locked, please request a new link' / 'This review link has expired. Please contact the Contract Owner for a new link'), not from a screenshot, so their visual match to a hypothetical design is unverified.

Attempt-count lockout (3 consecutive failures) is tracked client-side in OtpVerificationForm's component state only; it is not persisted, so a page reload resets the counter. The contract has no endpoint to read back a link's current failed-attempt count or lock status ahead of the next verify-otp call, so there is no way to make the lock durable across reloads without inventing one.
